select e.id, e.entry_key as entryKey, e.source_id as sourceId, e.title, e.category, e.group_slug as groupSlug, e.tags, e.license, e.status, e.source_url as sourceUrl, s.name as sourceName, g.name as groupName, left(coalesce(e.prompt, ''), 200) as preview from prompt_entry e left join prompt_source s on s.source_id = e.source_id left join prompt_group g on g.slug = e.group_slug
order by e.id limit #{offset}, #{size}

select e.id, e.entry_key as entryKey, e.source_id as sourceId, e.title, e.category, e.group_slug as groupSlug, e.tags, e.license, e.status, e.source_url as sourceUrl, e.prompt, s.name as sourceName, g.name as groupName from prompt_entry e left join prompt_source s on s.source_id = e.source_id left join prompt_group g on g.slug = e.group_slug where e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into prompt_entry (entry_key, source_id, title, category, group_slug, prompt, tags, license, status, source_url) values (#{entryKey}, #{sourceId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{groupSlug}, #{prompt}, #{tags}, #{license}, #{status}, #{sourceUrl})
mapper.select: select group_slug from prompt_entry where category = #{category} group by group_slug order by count(*) desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into prompt_source (source_id, name, url, license, summary, status) values ('manual', '手动添加', '', 'User-provided authorization', '用户手动添加的提示词', 'imported') on duplicate key update name = values(name), license = values(license), summary = values(summary), status = values(status)
mapper.select: select g.slug, g.name, count(e.id) as count from prompt_group g left join prompt_entry e on e.group_slug = g.slug group by g.slug, g.name, g.sort_order order by g.sort_order
select group_slug as groupSlug, category, count(*) as count from prompt_entry group by group_slug, category order by count desc

select s.source_id as sourceId, s.name, s.url, s.license, s.summary, s.status, count(e.id) as count from prompt_source s left join prompt_entry e on e.source_id = s.source_id group by s.source_id, s.name, s.url, s.license, s.summary, s.status, s.id order by s.id
